title: Make a stock reservation safe under concurrent writers
acceptanceCriteria: With no other writer, the stock drops by `quantity` and the function resolves to the row as stored (new version included)
Reserving exactly the remaining stock succeeds (2 of 2 leaves 0)
Short stock at the first read rejects with `OutOfStockError` without attempting a write
A versioned write that changed 0 rows is never reported as success
After another writer commits first, it re-reads and retries, so both writes count (10 → 7 by them → 5 by you)
Stock is re-checked on every attempt: if the other writer left too little, it rejects with `OutOfStockError` and writes nothing
It gives up with `ConflictError` after exactly `maxAttempts` conflicting writes
